gateway_config:
[openshell]
version = 2
[openshell.gateway]
bind_address = "0.0.0.0:18080"
health_bind_address = "0.0.0.0:18081"
compute_driver = "docker"
disable_tls = true
[openshell.gateway.auth]
allow_unauthenticated_users = true
[openshell.gateway.gateway_jwt]
signing_key_path = "$REPO/.tools/openshell-state/tls/jwt/signing.pem"
public_key_path = "$REPO/.tools/openshell-state/tls/jwt/public.pem"
kid_path = "$REPO/.tools/openshell-state/tls/jwt/kid"
gateway_id = "sandbox-matrix"
[openshell.drivers.docker]
sandbox_runtime_image = "ghcr.io/nvidia/openshell/sandbox:0.1.6"
supervisor_image = "ghcr.io/nvidia/openshell/supervisor:0.1.6"
image_pull_policy = "if_not_present"
sandbox_label = "sandbox-matrix"
app_armor_profile = "Unconfined"
